calls.title: Home page design brainstorm
calls.summary: The team discussed improvements to the homepage hero to create stronger visitor engagement and better articulate GrowthBook's value. Key points included enhancing the hero area for emotional impact, with suggestions for larger headings and rearranged elements to avoid a simplistic design. Navigation alignment and spacing issues were identified, proposing a full-width nav bar for better visual balance. Content adjustments like refining headline sizes were also considered, alongside moving certain elements from the hero to improve clarity. The plan includes making minor tweaks post-launch within five days, while ensuring the design maintains GrowthBook's pragmatic and straightforward brand identity.
calls.keywords: Homepage Hero, Layout Alignment, Button Design, Navigation Bar, Visual Hierarchy, User Engagement
